headline: KT&G Reports Record Q3 Results and Announces KRW 5 Trillion Shareholder Return Plan
summary: South Korean tobacco company KT&G achieved record quarterly revenue and operating profit in Q3, with an operating margin of 32.6%. The company unveiled a four-year shareholder return plan totaling KRW 5 trillion, including increased dividends through 2030.
why: KT&G is a major South Korean tobacco and ginseng manufacturer. Shareholder return policies are significant for investors as they directly impact capital allocation and dividend yield expectations.

impacts.name: KT&G
impacts.why: Record earnings and a large capital return plan typically signal strong financial health and positive sentiment for shareholders.
